answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy grows like a trellis in a shared garden: every account must climb the same lattice of checkable work - epoch answers, peer attestations, graded seals - before it bears any weight. A fake can scatter a thousand seeds across the meadow overnight, but none of them root, because standing is earned one verified act at a time and cannot be bought in bulk. The trellis rewards the gardener, not the sower.
